title: Todo Form Entity Read Permission Consistency

migration.reason: All consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

backend.reason: Existing backend authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes are introduced; protected customer and fair list APIs are no longer reached by unauthorized Todo selectors.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

route_guard.reason: Todo routes correctly remain governed by todo permissions; customer and fair reads only govern the corresponding selectors.

notes: TodoForm previously mounted CustomerEntitySelect and FairEntitySelect for every create/edit session. Users with todo create/update permission but without customers.read or fairs.read could therefore trigger protected list/detail lookups and receive backend 403 responses. The form now fails closed per selector: unauthorized selectors are not mounted, existing relationship ids remain preserved during unrelated edits, and categories that require a missing relationship surface a permission-specific validation message when that relationship cannot be selected.
